diagnosed_skill_and_repair.overall_diagnosis: The pipeline runs end-to-end and passes recall/duration checks but fails precision at 50% (6/12 detected segments match ground truth with IoU>0.3). The opening silence (0-221) is correctly detected. The failure mode is the pause-detector producing too many short, boundary-misaligned 2-3s pause segments with its permissive defaults (threshold-ratio=0.5, min-duration=2), plus the segment-combiner not merging adjacent fragments (e.g., 522-524 and 525-527 with 1s gap) that correspond to a single ground-truth pause. Note: a prior round attempted patch-mode edits to these same files but was rejected (gate_no_improve) because the proposed edits were empty replacements that stripped content without adding guidance. This round should use rewrite-mode or provide concrete additive content: stricter recommended defaults AND explicit merging logic.

skills.name: pause-detector
skills.heading: Pause Detector
skills.diagnosis: Default parameters (threshold-ratio=0.5, min-duration=2) produce many short false-positive and boundary-misaligned 2s pauses that fail IoU>0.3 matching. The skill lacks guidance on precision-oriented tuning and on merging adjacent low-energy windows before applying min-duration filtering. Approximately half the emitted segments do not match ground truth.
skills.repair_instruction: Rewrite pause-detector/SKILL.md (do not use empty patch replacements - the prior patch attempt was rejected for stripping content without adding value). Preserve all existing sections and ADD the following concrete content: (1) A new 'Recommended Settings for Lecture/Teaching Videos' section that explicitly recommends --threshold-ratio 0.4 and --min-duration 3 for IoU-based evaluation tasks, with rationale that 2s detections at 1-second window granularity frequently misalign with ground truth. (2) Guidance in 'How It Works' that adjacent low-energy windows separated by <=1 second should be merged into one segment BEFORE applying the min-duration filter, improving boundary accuracy. (3) A 'Precision vs Recall Tuning' subsection explaining the tradeoff and noting that for video-silence-remover-style tasks, favor precision. (4) A concrete example invocation: `--threshold-ratio 0.4 --min-duration 3 --window-size 30`. Keep the existing parameter list and output format intact.

skills.name: segment-combiner
skills.heading: Segment Combiner
skills.diagnosis: The combiner only sorts and concatenates segments without merging adjacent or overlapping ones. Fragmented detections like {522-524} and {525-527} (1s gap) remain separate, hurting IoU precision against ground truth that treats contiguous low-energy regions as a single pause.
skills.repair_instruction: Rewrite segment-combiner/SKILL.md (prior patch-mode attempt was rejected for empty replacements). Preserve existing content and ADD: (1) A new `--merge-gap` parameter (default: 2 seconds) in the Parameters section that merges segments whose gap is <= the threshold into a single contiguous segment after sorting. (2) An updated Output Format example showing merged segments (e.g., {522-524} and {525-527} becoming {522-527}). (3) A note in the Notes section explicitly stating 'Segments within merge-gap seconds of each other are merged into one; the output contains no overlaps and no gaps smaller than merge-gap.' (4) A concrete example invocation: `--segments initial_silence.json pauses.json --merge-gap 2 --output all_segments.json`. The repair should be additive content, not deletion of existing documentation.

repair_outcome.analysis: A skill was localized and rewritten, but the comparable method-skill run still failed; likely causes are insufficient repair content or downstream model execution limits.
